title: Karnataka puts brakes on registration of Green SM cabs amid protest by taxi unions

ai.summary: Karnataka government halted registration of Green SM cabs following taxi unions' protests, with unions claiming the company's proposed Rs 8 per km pricing would undercut government rates.

facts.claim: Karnataka government halted registration of Green SM cabs
facts.quote: Karnataka puts brakes on registration of Green SM cabs amid protest by taxi unions

facts.claim: unions claimed the company's proposed Rs 8 per km pricing would undercut government rates
facts.quote: The company reportedly plans to offer services at Rs 8 per km, much lower than the government’s charges.

ai.background_note: Karnataka taxi unions protested against Green SM cabs' proposed pricing, which they said would undercut government rates, leading to a temporary halt in registration.
